officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen Halland: Sandsjöbacka
officialSources.note: Official reserve source. Confirms Sandsjöbacka is Halland's largest land nature reserve, split into northern and southern parts, with Natura 2000 context and rules including no tent/caravan camping, fire only at designated places and dogs leashed. Also states there are toilets at Sandsjöbackamotet parking areas and that Hagryd-Dala access had limited accessibility through April 2026.

officialSources.title: Västkuststiftelsen: Sandsjöbacka

Parking links expose Grönabur p-plats at about 57.52949554,12.04073534, roughly 23 m from the K1 GPX start.

importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: Hallandsleden Kusten starts in Sandsjöbacka nature reserve and soon passes under the E6/E20 and by the 2018 ecoduct. The first kilometers follow paths through a varied landscape of forest, small lakes and rocky hills, with a worthwhile detour to the Björkris viewpoint. The section continues through Björkris, passes Hede station, and follows Kungsbackaån through Stadshusparken to the strong transit endpoint at Kungsbacka C.
